WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
q3 AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, MIN(d.calendar_date) mn, MAX(d.calendar_date) mx, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.region, ty.net_sales AS fy2025_26, ly.net_sales AS fy2024_25,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct, ty.stores, ly.stores, ty.mn, ty.mx, ly.mn, ly.mx
FROM q3 ty JOIN q3 ly ON ly.region = ty.region AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.region;

SELECT d.fiscal_year,
  COUNT(*) AS line_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_line_ids,
  COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_receipt_line,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_all,
  MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) mn_etl, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) mx_etl,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) n_etl
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT d.fiscal_year, cs.region, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctrl_net, COUNT(*) AS rows_, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) st, COUNT(DISTINCT r.business_date) days
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = r.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25') AND d.fiscal_quarter = 3 AND r.store_id <> 999
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1;
